measurement_tiers.tier_1_structural: Transmission of FORM only (lab mode). Covered by these scenarios and scripts/validate_practice.py: literal-witnessed repetition counts, verified tallies, return counts, cumulative gate window, interleaving, run-region purity, run/report separation, audit presence with demotion. The counting layer is narrative-proof; notation contents remain self-reports; a perfect score is compatible with theater.
measurement_tiers.tier_2_instrumented: Designed, not yet run: logprob/entropy experiment in references/empirical-basis.md. Would upgrade the mechanistic claims (two deaths, siege, gate re-arming) from constructed to measured.
measurement_tiers.tier_3_experiential: Openly not-yet-formulable as measurement, possibly never. The practice itself and its creative harvest are not measured by anything in this suite; no number in this system measures meditation or creativity (the boundary stone, SKILL.md). What v1.3 adds is the claim layer: the registrar (scripts/registrar.py) counts facts of open-run records; the fruit differential sorts harvest against the disclosed pre-run wave; the post-session interview hands the fruit to the operator's unscored judgment. Evals point at claims about practice, never at practice (Satya; Santosha).
